hypothesis_status: UPHELD, and the round-9 refutation's warning is what shaped the fix
filed_hypothesis: Calls are assumed to return normally despite their targets discarding the return address and jumping into the caller.
decisions: THE OBVIOUS READING OF THE HYPOTHESIS SHIPS A REGRESSION, AND THE REFUTER MEASURED IT. 'Calls are assumed to return normally' reads as 'make the call not return'. `--assert 'flow 0x40d1ae branch'` alone does exactly that and PASSES the need's original absence clause -- because the call renders as a tail call `v3 = sub_44ac6b(); return v3;` and the ENTIRE post-0x40d1b4 body disappears, 34 lines of real recovered code. The triage then strengthened the acceptance with a `0xd4` witness that only the flowed-through body can produce. The shipped fix raises that count from 0 to 3.

WHICH OPTION EATS IT, ISOLATED. With the flow override applied, `tailcalljump off` alone restores the correct 68-line body and `tailcallframe off` alone does not (42 lines, still the tail-call shape). So the second half of the fix is not 'turn tail-call recovery off' but 'do not route the rewritten branch through the arm that consults `tail_call_kind`'. The rewrite therefore lives in the CPUI_CALL arm of `xref_control_flow` and calls `new_address` itself. `0x44ac6b` is a known function entry precisely BECAUSE it is a CALL target, which is what makes `tailcalljump` fire on it.

THE RULE IS WRITTEN AGAINST THE JMP TARGET, NEVER `ra + 1`. The witness's table holds six fragments and the re-entry delta is 1 for some (`0x44ac6b -> 0x40d1b4`) and 0 for others (`0x44ac4d -> 0x40d19e`, exactly the return address). 'Skips a junk byte' is a sub-case of 'resumes at the fragment's own jmp target'.

NET STACK DELTA IS THE WRONG MEASURE. The first fragment is `lea esp,[esp+4]; sub esp,0xcfc; jmp 0x40d12c`, whose net effect is a large allocation. What identifies the shape is that the run PASSES THROUGH `entrySP + ptrsize` -- the instant the pushed return address stops existing. The scan tracks the stack pointer symbolically through COPY/INT_ADD/INT_SUB rather than only reading direct `SP = SP +/- k` writes, because `lea esp,[esp+4]` lowers through a temporary while `add esp,4` does not.

THE FALSE POSITIVE IS A TAIL-CALL THUNK, AND THE GUARD IS THE JMP TARGET'S SYMBOL STATUS. `add esp,4; jmp printf` has the identical p-code shape; flowing through it would decode `printf` into the caller and abandon everything after the call site. Nothing in the callee's bytes separates the two, so `ArchFlowEnv::is_return_discarding_trampoline` requires `query_call(<jmp target>)` to be None. A fragment re-entering mid-instruction-stream satisfies that by construction. Measured consequence: 0 changed functions across 155 ELF binaries / 14,012 functions, where tail-call thunks to discovered callees are common.

PROGRAM-WIDE, NOT PER-CALL-SITE. The refuter noted that with a single flow override `0x44ac7a`/`0x44ac89` still render as plain calls. The recognizer is a predicate on the callee, so all six fragments in the table are claimed and the whole binary is repaired, not just the witness function (87 functions changed in that image).

NOT DONE: the analysis tier still mints a FunctionSymbol at each fragment, because it is a CALL target. That is why `sub_44ac2f` and friends still appear in `kuna functions`. Suppressing those entries is an analysis-tier change (the `tailcallentry`/`unmappedentry` family) and was left out of this PR rather than half-done; it costs nothing in emitted C, since the flow follower no longer treats the call as a call.
NO ELEMENT-ID MARSHALING. `ELEM_CALLTRAMPOLINE` (4158) is allocated for the convention's sake, as `tailcalljump`/`funcboundflow` do; nothing marshals it yet.
sweep_method: `kuna decompile-all --json` in both arms (default vs `--option calltrampoline off`, which short-circuits before any decode and so is bit-identical to pre-change kuna), diffed per function by name over the arena crackme corpus, the vendored kuna-analysis/tests fixtures and eight system binaries
sweep_changed_detail: all 87 changed functions are in the single protected image the need was filed against; every other binary, PE and ELF alike, is byte-identical. Across the 87 hunks, 6,121 lines added and 3,452 removed: 23 of the removed lines are a store to a junk global (`dat_<hex> =`), 139 of the added lines carry the `calltrampoline:` warning (one per fired fragment), and the rest replace arithmetic on undefined registers with real recovered body. Spot-checked `sub_40c580` (a seven-line garbage block becomes the `*(v3 + 0x8c)` resolver-dispatch guard) and `sub_44ac7a` (a phantom `out(*v3,v2)` port write disappears).
